name: Yoshino Hotaru
source: The new mysterious transfer student that transferred at a strange time. When the protagonist created the baby club, in front of the club poster, she said "so this poster is the beginning of everything". She can magically tell the future like a seer as if she came from the future. She reveals quite a bit of the future and provides recommendations.
